## Methods

### Design and analytic samples

- Study sample: HRS/HCAP 2016 participants, N = `r format(nrow(analysis2_hcap), big.mark = ",")`
  - All HCAP participants; no Core cognitive-test requirement
  - Participants without Core cognitive testing classified from informant data (Jorm IQCODE): core algorithm Jorm fallback; PMM informant model
  - Agreement-statistic samples: core algorithm N = `r format(analysis2_n_compare[["core_algorithm"]], big.mark = ",")`; PMM N = `r format(analysis2_n_compare[["pmm"]], big.mark = ",")`
  - [Provenance: R/MS_MAIN/MS_001_analysis_cohort.R; R_objects/A7_005_hrs16_merged.rds; R/A7_100-comparison_of_diagnoses.R; R/PMM_110_Comparison_of_Consensus_Langa_Weir.R]
- Consensus panel subset
  - Validation-subsample design; inverse-probability weighting to account for selection into the consensus panel
  - [Provenance: R/A7_100-comparison_of_diagnoses.R; R/PMM_110_Comparison_of_Consensus_Langa_Weir.R]

### HRS Core classification approaches

- Two Core classification approaches
  - Core algorithm
    - Survey-weighted CFA; demographically normed cognitive score; cognitive/self-report/informant rules
    - [Provenance: R/A7_050-mplus_model.R; R/A7_055-norm_factor_score.R; R/A7_075-implement_algorithm.R]
  - PMM
    - HRS/HCAP-calibrated probabilistic Normal/MCI/Dementia classification; combined cognition and informant models (i.e., two PMM models, one trained using cognition data, the other trained using informant data (Jorm IQCODE)).
    - _Limitation_: The HRS/HCAP IQCODE look back window is the past 10 years, the Core IQCODE has a look back window of 2 years.
    - [Provenance: R/PMM_102_calibration_model.R; R/PMM_103_informant_model.R; R/PMM_110_Comparison_of_Consensus_Langa_Weir.R]

#### Core algorithm
  - Single-factor Core cognition model
    - Not enough items to separately score 5 domains matching Manly et al. (2022)
    - Initial 8-indicator, complex-survey model fit evaluated with WLSMV
    - Factor scores estimated with MLR, a probit link, and EAP scoring after fixing item parameters to the MLR model estimates
    - Factor-score normalization; age, sex, race/ethnicity, education covariates
    - [Provenance: R/A7_050-mplus_model.R; mplus_output/A7/model_1a_fixed/model_1a_fixed.inp; R/A7_055-norm_factor_score.R]

  - Rule-based classification
    - Cognitive thresholds; self-reported concern; JORM for missing cognitive assessments
    - Normal, MCI, Dementia output
    - More detail in **Appendix 1**
    - [Provenance: R/A7_075-implement_algorithm.R]

#### PMM classification

- HRS/HCAP calibration
  - Known-class Manly-Jones algorithm classification (training data; Muthén, 2002)
  - Same inputs as core algorithm: 8 Core cognitive tests; self-rated memory (D102); Jorm IQCODE
    - Not included: ADL/IADL items (reason for a limitation not asked; physical causes); immediate word recall (little beyond delayed recall; Jones et al., 2024)
  - Cognition model, N = `r format(analysis2_pmm_n[["cognition"]], big.mark = ",")` (at least 1 test score or D102)
    - General cognitive factor (GCP) on the 8 tests; GCP mean and variance by class (Normal: mean 0, variance 1)
    - Loadings, intercepts, thresholds, residual variances equal across classes; D102 thresholds by class
    - Test regressions on `r analysis2_pmm_n_cov_terms` sociodemographic terms fixed at robust norms group values
  - Informant model, N = `r format(analysis2_pmm_n[["informant"]], big.mark = ",")` (IQCODE, no test score or D102)
    - Jorm IQCODE only; mean by class
  - Calibration parameters fixed for scoring; scored in the same HRS/HCAP sample used for calibration (in-sample classification); HRS Core 2016-2022 scoring in Analysis A3_2 (not reported here)
  - [Provenance: R/PMM_100_norming_npb.R; R/PMM_102_calibration_model.R; R/PMM_103_informant_model.R; R/PMM_090_model_registry.R]
- Choice of a general factor
  - Tests correlate within class (robust norms group, after adjustment); model without GCP sets within-class correlation to 0, treats correlated tests as independent evidence
  - GCP model: better fit, fewer parameters than no-factor model
  - Class-specific test intercepts and thresholds: 10-fold cross-validation; higher kappa, lower log score; not adopted
  - [Values not in a current results object; Provenance: References/SESSION_LOGS.md, 2026-10-22; R/Archive_PMM_2026-10-22/]
- Class proportions (priors)
  - Class-specific parameters estimated with HCAP16WGTR; MLR estimation, Bayes-rule posterior classification (plug-in rule; McLachlan, 1992)
  - Class proportions fixed at the HCAP16WGTR-weighted Manly-Jones algorithm distribution, computed outside Mplus; Mplus KNOWNCLASS estimates class proportions from unweighted counts
    - Cognition model: `r analysis2_pmm_priors[["cognition"]]`
    - Informant model: `r analysis2_pmm_priors[["jorm"]]`
  - [Provenance: R/PMM_101_mplus_function.R; R/PMM_102_calibration_model.R; R/PMM_103_informant_model.R; R/Archive_PMM_2026-10-22/PMM_104_weight_check.R; scoring outputs in R/PMM_090_model_registry.R]
- Combined classification
  - Cognition-model probabilities; informant-model probabilities when IQCODE available
  - Probabilistic Normal/MCI/Dementia membership; replicated probability-weighted comparisons
  - More detail in **Appendix 2**
  - [Provenance: R/PMM_110_Comparison_of_Consensus_Langa_Weir.R]

### Comparison classifications and estimands

- Primary comparator: Manly-Jones algorithm
  - HCAP population weights: HCAP16WGTR
  - [Provenance: R/A7_100-comparison_of_diagnoses.R]
- Secondary comparators
  - HCAP consensus diagnosis: normalized HCAP16WGTR x samplingP^-1 weights
  - Langa-Weir; Hudomiet classification
  - [Provenance: R/A0_017-recode_classification.R; R/A7_100-comparison_of_diagnoses.R]
- Agreement estimands
  - 3-class quadratic weighted kappa
  - Dementia versus non-dementia kappa
  - Marginal Normal/MCI/Dementia distributions
  - [Provenance: R/MS_MAIN/MS_010_results_objects.R]
